note: Expanded cohort studies (Rots et al., 2023) confirm intellectual disability, speech/motor delay, and ASD as core recurring phenotypic features across cohorts.

evidence.text: The expanded cohort redefines the KDM6B-related clinical spectrum, highlighting core recurring neurodevelopmental manifestations including intellectual disability, autism spectrum disorder, and developmental delays.

source.title: The clinical and molecular spectrum of the KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: Taken together, we accurately define the broad clinical spectrum of the KDM6B-related NDD

evidence.text: While speech and motor impairment are characteristic of KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder, occasional patients present without language impairment, indicating some phenotypic variability.
